title: Nepal Police Publishes Details of 87 Bodies Recovered After Rasuwa Flood
description:
Kathmandu. Nepal Police has published details of 87 people who died in the Bhotekoshi flood in Rasuwa on its online portal to help families identify missing relatives and claim unidentified bodies.

The portal has been developed to provide relatives with accessible information about people who died in the disaster, particularly those whose identities have not yet been established.
